narrative: On 15 June 2025, total network ridership was 178,420 — a decline of 6.6% against the prior-day baseline of 191,050. Metro ridership fell most sharply at 11.1%, driven primarily by the Vastral station, where a gate fault during morning peak hours coincided with heavy rainfall of 22 mm. The Bhat–Shivranjani BRTS route recorded a 15.3% ridership decline; no incident was logged, though rainfall may have been a contributing factor. The Maninagar–Satellite AMTS route declined 14.7% with no supporting evidence. Investigation of Vastral gate restoration and passenger communication is the immediate priority.
